High_Aspect_Soaring_Wings.description: Massive, deeply elongated wings structured for generating immense lift over vast distances. Built to ride invisible thermal columns for hours with practically no energetic expenditure, allowing for devastating, high-speed stoops.

Elliptical_Maneuvering_Wings.description: Short, deeply rounded wings equipped with highly slotted primary feathers. They provide explosive, near-instantaneous liftoff and unparalleled maneuverability, allowing the entity to thread through dense woodland canopies effortlessly.
